title: Fetched whole, reduced locally — the baseline
why: What an ad-hoc copy costs, produced by the same runtime and the same spec rather than asserted as a denominator. VISLANG_REMOTE=off routes the identical chain down the whole-FOLDER fetch (planner._plan_remote_folder falls through to _fetch_remote_folder), so the narrowing runs here.
expect: ~20.94 GB over the wire — the entire series, every field, every timestep — for the same ~41 MB result, a ~505x transfer penalty; wall clock dominated entirely by the rsync, plus 20.94 GB of local disk under .vislang/downloads/. Note the local materialize reads a file rsync wrote seconds earlier, so it is served warm from the page cache (cf. E1c_local).

expect: HELD over budget (1 GiB / 3 s defaults); 0 bulk bytes; an estimate of ~6.98 GB over the wire against a ~128 MB result.
